releaseName: Lokify v1.4.7 – Android Package Installer Authorization & Direct Lokify.apk Installation
releaseNotes:
• Android Package Installer Authorization: Added REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission and automatic permission settings handler so downloaded updates install directly.
• Direct Lokify.apk Installation: Automatically grants URI permissions to system PackageInstaller and launches the install prompt.
• Native Android Google Account Chooser: Real device Google accounts picker (Amazon-style).
• Clean Production: Zero guest mode, zero mock accounts.
